old: A whole C-class range is one contiguous /24 prefix: 256 addresses behind one announcing AS and one registration class, held by one customer. In the United States the range is USD 500 a month, USD 1.95 per address; the single static ISP product is USD 2.80 per IP for 30 days, so 256 addresses cost USD 499.20 a month as a range against USD 716.80 bought singly, about 30 percent less per address, with no added failure domains. No test address, no ASN and no prefix is published for the range product; the vendor offers free trials for some plans through customer service, and uses IPinfo as its reference for an address's region. A check of a delivered range takes a RIPE or ARIN whois lookup on one address for the registration class and a looking glass for the announcing AS.
new: A whole C-class range is one contiguous /24 prefix: 256 addresses behind one announcing AS and one registration class, allocated whole to one customer. In the United States the range is USD 500 a month (a 30-day order line) at 100 Mbps, about USD 1.95 per address, and the range order total is the listed price times the number of ranges, with no quantity discount. The single static ISP product lists USD 2.80 per IP for 30 days in the United States, and its order total takes a quantity discount: 5 percent off for 1-5 IPs, 10 percent for 6-49, 15 percent for 50-199, 20 percent for 200-799 and 25 percent for 800 or more. 256 single addresses therefore come to USD 573.44 for 30 days (USD 716.80 at list price, less 20 percent), USD 2.24 per address, and the range costs about 13 percent less per address. No test address, no ASN and no prefix is published for the range product; the vendor offers free trials for some plans through customer service, and uses IPinfo as its reference for an address's region. A check of a delivered range takes a RIPE or ARIN whois lookup on one address for the registration class and a looking glass for the announcing AS.
